decoy_patterns.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {id: 'CUS-C12B'})-[old:HAS_PHONE]->(p:Phone {id: 'PHN-C12-SHARED'})<-[current:HAS_PHONE]-(ring:Customer) WHERE old.valid_to < current.valid_from RETURN c, old, p, current, ring
decoy_patterns.name: expired recycled-phone link to porch ring
decoy_patterns.why_irrelevant: The control customer stopped owning the number before any ring member's ownership began and before this purchase.

intake: Tracking shows delivered but the photo is not my house and I never received it.
misleading_surface: A recycled phone number creates an apparent porch-ring link even though ownership ended before the purchase.

proof_patterns.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispute {id: 'DSP-2026-90122'})-[:FILED_BY]->(c:Customer)-[l:LIVES_AT]->(home:Address), (d)-[:DISPUTES]->(t:Transaction)-[:FOR_ORDER]->(o:PurchaseOrder)-[:SHIPPED_AS]->(s:Shipment)-[:DELIVERED_TO]->(wrong:Address) WHERE home.id <> wrong.id AND l.valid_to IS NULL RETURN d, c, home, t, o, s, wrong
proof_patterns.name: delivery address differs from current residence

proof_patterns.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispute {id: 'DSP-2026-90122'})-[:REQUESTED]->(r:EvidenceRequest) WHERE r.status = 'no_response' AND r.deadline_passed = true RETURN d, r
proof_patterns.name: merchant missed evidence deadline
